title: Implement useTodos custom hook with localStorage persistence
active_form: Implementing useTodos custom hook with localStorage persistence
description:
Create the useTodos custom hook that wraps todoReducer with useReducer. On initialization, load persisted todos from localStorage (key: 'todos'). After each state change, sync the updated todos array to localStorage as a side effect using useEffect. Expose dispatch wrapper functions for each action (addTodo, deleteTodo, toggleTodo, editTodo, clearCompleted, toggleAll) and the current todos array. Handle localStorage read/write errors gracefully — if storage is unavailable, the app should still work in-memory and surface an error for the toast system.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Section 7.1

functional: Hook initializes state from localStorage on mount
Hook exposes todos array and action functions (addTodo, deleteTodo, toggleTodo, editTodo, clearCompleted, toggleAll)
State changes sync to localStorage via useEffect
edge_cases: localStorage is empty on first load — initializes with empty array
localStorage contains invalid JSON — falls back to empty array
error_handling: localStorage write failure does not crash the app
localStorage errors are surfaced for toast notification
performance: localStorage reads/writes do not block the UI thread

testing_requirements.target: Action functions dispatch correct reducer actions
State syncs to localStorage after changes
